# Harbour mining

Used in [Air Game — bombing](/rules/air/60-bombing).

## Table

| Bombload | Mined |
|---|---|
| 0–5 | 0 |
| 6–10 | 1 |
| 11–15 | 2 |
| 16–20 | 3 |
| 21–25 | 4 |
| 26–30 | 5 |
| 31+ | 6 |

## Notes

- Mining Harbor by Plane Table, printed 41.39 on chart page 11 (jp2 105); the rules list it as 41.52. Read twice, from the archive.org scan and the community chart PDFs (Shared Charts.pdf p. 11): 0 of 7 cells differ.
- One die per six aircraft laying mines; bombload is the average bomb load of those six (not their total). At or under mined, the harbour gets one mine counter.
